* '''PC-E2''' ([[Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). If a Dark Jedi (or two Imperials) control this location, place this Effect out of play. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Errata)]] (published 9 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Front) / •Sacrifice For Something Bigger (Back)”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). The two sides are printed as two slips (page 4). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
